svg.title: Untitled
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Curved upper-left side and three straight sides preserved; contour approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://high.org/collection/untitled-341/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
